defaultDescription: Guided lessons and interview practice for software engineers: programming foundations, data structures and algorithms, production backend work and system design, so you can understand and verify the code AI writes.

learn.label: Learn
learn.description: Build durable engineering foundations. Master languages, data structures, algorithms, object design, and engineering tools before production and architecture decisions demand them.

grow.label: Grow
grow.description: Turn knowledge into production judgment. Learn to design, deliver, diagnose, secure, and operate the systems a senior engineer is trusted to own.

blaze.label: Blaze
blaze.description: Prepare for the decisions beyond implementation. Frame ambiguous systems, defend trade-offs, lead through evidence, and communicate the judgment expected in senior and staff-level interviews.

learn/hands-on-dsa.description: Start from the pattern you just learned, trace its state on a real input, then move to problems that make you adapt the same reasoning.

start-free.description: Lessons you can read today. Open lessons need no account; lessons marked Free with account need a free sign-in.

pricing.description: Sample plans and prices for Look Ahead. Prices are not final.

search.description: Find courses, lessons, interview questions, and practice in one place.
